items.title: John Pizzarelli, Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We’ve got do a Christmas record with you and we’ll get all the best arrangers... We’ll get Johnny Mandel... And there’s Clare Fischer, and there’s John Clayton, there’s Patrick Williams, there’s Johnny Mandel... But the record gets made.

ctx.x: Wow. You’ve had, it seems like, pretty good success with record label support. I was looking at your Christmas album and I’m seeing Don Sebesky, Pat Williams, Clare Fisher.
